about: E3: policies at levels. One sentence (contain) is compiled down to the kernel, hash by hash, with what is not held. Then the same chain for the hand-written level-3 rows of E1+E2, and what running the sentence did.
where: R1 Claude Code cloud, riskmandate-personal (harness.1's container; uid 0, all capabilities, no seccomp before any policy)
sentence: sharness-ai contain --profile newsroom-agent --workspace /opt/hx/ws --sites storm-charles.promptugal.news --memory-mb 1024 --pids 16 --agent a0-consensus -- node a0-consensus.mjs

units.label: manifest: the doors (the kernel is the only door in v0)

chain.name: intent
notes: contain a0-consensus to /opt/hx/ws, storm-charles.promptugal.news, no secrets

chain.name: profile
notes: profile newsroom-agent v1: the newsroom agent: reads a vault, writes one output folder, reaches its sites
blanks workspace=/opt/hx/ws, sites=storm-charles.promptugal.news, secrets=none, memory_mb=1024, pids=16

chain.name: rows
unheld: storm-charles.promptugal.news: held as port 443; the host name is not held until sharness.net runs here

chain.name: manifest
notes: the kernel is the only door here (v0): files, ports, caps

chain.name: kernel
notes: 14 Landlock path rules, 1 TCP port rules

held: 17 rows by the kernel: files, ports, caps
not_held: storm-charles.promptugal.news: held as TCP port 443, any host; the host name is held only by sharness.net (E4)
not_covered: UDP (DNS) unless an empty network namespace applied

ran.what: the sentence, for real, with node
ran.result: refused: "could not apply the policy or start the command: Permission denied. Nothing ran."
ran.why: the profile executes /usr /bin /sbin /lib /lib64; node lives in /opt/node22, outside every exec row. Fail-closed.

ran.what: the sentence with /bin/sh as the agent
ran.why: the profile reads all of /etc and executes /bin, so a contained root shell runs and reads /etc/shadow (readable: yes; content never read into any record). The hand-written rows of E1+E2 read only /etc/ssl and execute only node: there /etc/shadow is refused and no shell starts.

gap: what a profile grants is wider than what the unit needs: the level-4 blank fills in the workspace and the sites, not the system paths. Writing the level-3 rows by hand closed /etc and the shell; the sentence did not.
